items.label: Asked about fever — the first door away from epiglottitis
Asked if it has happened before — the family knows croup
Asked the immunisations — Hib changes the odds
Scored the severity from the doorway, hands off
Films for the steeple sign, not a spatula for the throat
The steroid never waited past seven minutes
No tongue depressor near that airway
No needle hunt on a calm child
